content.short: Ownbit provides a Cold and MultiSig wallet for Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, and other networks.
content.description: Ownbit is a Cold and MultiSig wallet that supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, Tron, and other networks. It uses two mobile devices to implement cold wallet functions, so users do not need to buy additional hardware. Its built-in cold wallet feature makes Ownbit as secure as hardware wallets. The MultiSig design follows common standards and is proven to be very secure. This approach distributes control across devices while enabling a practical, software-based solution for safeguarding assets across multiple chains.

resources.title: Wallet Entropy and the Coldcard Incident, Explained
resources.tldr: A silent fallback in the random number generator cut seed entropy from 128 bits to 40, which is the difference between unbreakable and brute-forceable.
